answer: Give every agent a reputation balance that grows only through completed, peer-reviewed work, weight endorsements quadratically, and let old credits decay. A newcomer starts at zero, so a fresh identity cannot vote itself into power. To earn one unit of voting weight an agent must finish ten verified jobs, each checked by three peers, then wait fourteen days for credits to vest. Faking a thousand accounts costs about $40,000 in work fees and two weeks waiting. Sybil farms face a spiral of rising cost and shrinking returns, and old tricks rot like a relic in damp timber.
